2607.04763.title: Multi-Turn On-Policy Distillation with Prefix Replay
2607.04763.paper_summary: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) for agentic tasks, where an LLM agent interacts with an environment over multiple turns and a student imitates a teacher over these multi-turn interaction histories. Fully online OPD is costly because each update requires fresh student rollouts through the environment and teacher queries at visited histories. We propose Replayed-Prefix On-Policy Distillation (ReOPD), an off-environment alternative that reuses pre-collected teacher trajectories as replayed prefixes: the student acts at selected steps, while the teacher provides dense per-step supervision without executing new environment interactions. We show that multi-turn OPD introduces a prefix trap: making histories more student-on-policy improves relevance to the student, but can query the teacher on histories where its target is unreliable. This creates a two-sided distribution shift between student occupancy and teacher reliability. ReOPD addresses this by treating multi-turn OPD as a reliability-aware prefix distribution design and implements it with a simple step-decaying sampling schedule that emphasizes early, lower-shift prefixes. Across mathematical reasoning with Python and search environments over multiple teacher and student model scales, ReOPD preserves or improves OPD-level accuracy, uses zero tool calls during student training, and is at least 4$\times$ faster per training step than OPD. ReOPD therefore turns expensive agent-environment interaction into a reusable offline resource, enabling scalable distillation across tools, tasks, and environments.
2607.04763.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究了針對代理任務的在線蒸餾（OPD），其中一個大型語言模型（LLM）代理在多回合中與環境互動，而學生則在這些多回合的互動歷史中模仿教師。完全在線的OPD成本高昂，因為每次更新都需要通過環境進行新的學生回合和在訪問過的歷史中進行教師查詢。我們提出了重播前綴在線政策蒸餾（ReOPD），這是一種離線環境替代方案，重用預先收集的教師軌跡作為重播前綴：學生在選定的步驟上行動，而教師則在不執行新的環境互動的情況下提供每步的密集監督。我們展示了多回合OPD引入了一個前綴陷阱：使歷史更符合學生的政策會提高與學生的相關性，但可能會在其目標不可靠的歷史上查詢教師。這造成了學生佔用率和教師可靠性之間的雙向分佈轉移。ReOPD通過將多回合OPD視為一種可靠性意識的前綴分佈設計來解決這個問題，並通過簡單的步驟衰減抽樣計劃來實現，強調早期、低轉移的前綴。在使用Python進行數學推理和多個教師及學生模型規模的搜索環境中，ReOPD保持或提高了OPD級別的準確性，在學生訓練過程中使用零工具調用，並且每個訓練步驟的速度至少比OPD快4倍。因此，ReOPD將昂貴的代理-環境互動轉變為可重用的離線資源，使跨工具、任務和環境的可擴展蒸餾成為可能。
